messages:
nina_eng: Scheduling small schema change tonight 02:00 UTC: add tenant_prefs.jsonb + ghost index + backfill. Deploybot will run DDL + backfill. Need soft-quarantine + automated rollback gate.

deploybot: Job scheduled: dbmig-171671 (2024-12-23 02:00 UTC). Holdpoints: ghost-build, soft-quarantine(5%), pause-replicas, post-validate. Notifying: @raj_db @sylvia_sre @anya_pm.

raj_db: SQL is trivial. Backfill risk: replica apply lag. Plan: create index concurrently, run chunked backfill at 100 rows/s, chunk_size=800. Abort if replica lag >50s for 2min.

sylvia_sre: Add pre-step to pause replica replay during final attach. Also set finalization timeout 180s; if exceeded -> abort and leave ghost index for GC.

raj_db: Hook script added (deploybot pre-hook): ```bash
replica-manager pause --cluster=prod --until=02:10 --reason=migration-tenantprefs
```

anya_pm: Product confirms feature-flag fallback is enabled. If we roll back we flip the flag -> zero customer impact.

oncall_bot: Configure rollback rule: if http_5xx_5m > 2x baseline sustained 5m OR sample-mismatch >0.1% -> stop rollout, revert metadata, page oncall.

deploybot: Rollback thresholds registered. Soft-quarantine: route 5% traffic for 10m then run sample_validate (2000 tenants).

raj_db: sample_validate exits nonzero if mismatches >0.1%. Backfill config: {"rate":100, "chunk_size":800, "parallel":3}.

sylvia_sre: Runbook snippets:
# stop rollout
deploybot stop dbmig-171671
# revert schema meta
db-meta set-schema-version prod v1
# resume replicas
replica-manager resume --cluster=prod

nina_eng: Preflight checks passed. I'll monitor the thread during the window. Ping @nina_eng for any manual rollback decisions.

oncall_bot: Oncall: sylvia (primary), marc (backup). Will page on rollback.

deploybot: Final: scheduled -> 02:00 UTC. Progress updates will be posted here.
